1442040.sourceDescription:
## Features
- IP65 Waterproof LED String Lights
- Connectable Up To 100m Length
- Warm/Cool White Energy Saving LEDs

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a white rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White or Warm White to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

1566140.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Matching character collection
- 6-piece Disney character bundle
- Characters from 4 Disney worlds

## Information
Bring together a colourful collection of much loved Disney characters with this six piece infinity mirror light bundle, featuring Woody, Lotso, Elsa, Olaf, Stitch and Winnie the Pooh. Designed for indoor display, this varied character collection is ideal for bedrooms, playrooms, desks, shelves or larger Disney themed displays. Woody features 39 multicolour SMD LEDs, while Lotso adds 45 multicolour LEDs, bringing two distinctive Toy Story characters together with the eye catching infinity mirror effect. Elsa features 33 multicolour SMD LEDs for a touch of Frozen magic, while Olaf complements her with his own colourful mirrored illumination and playful character design. Stitch adds a further 39 multicolour SMD LEDs, while Winnie the Pooh features 45 multicolour SMD LEDs, giving the collection even more colour and character. Across each design, the mirrored construction reflects the LEDs repeatedly to create the illusion of light continuing deeper and deeper into the decoration. Compact and easy to incorporate into indoor spaces, the character lights use USB power and feature discreet clear lead cables for flexible positioning. Display all six together for a colourful Disney feature, group characters such as Elsa and Olaf or Woody and Lotso as matching pairs, or spread them throughout the room to create your own character collection.

1620940.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 1440 red and warm white LEDs create a vibrant, traditional Christmas lighting display.
- The ClusterBrights design places LEDs closer together than standard string lights for a fuller, denser lighting effect.
- The 18.5m illuminated section provides generous coverage for trees, garlands, fences, balconies and larger festive displays.
- Select from multiple lighting effects, while the timer runs the lights for 8 hours and switches them off for 16 hours.
- For indoor and outdoor Christmas decorating, with a dark green cable that blends discreetly among foliage and greenery.
- 18.5m illuminated length and 26.5m total length, including the power cable.
- Mains powered with an approximately 8m dark green power cable.
- Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorating, with the transformer kept indoors.
- A dense arrangement of 1440 red and warm white multi-action LEDs.
- Includes a 1-year warranty.

## Information
Create a vibrant festive display with these Samuel Alexander ClusterBrights Christmas string lights. Featuring 1440 red and warm white LEDs, they combine classic Christmas colour with a cosy glow. The closely positioned LEDs produce a fuller, more concentrated effect than traditional string lights, making them ideal for trees, garlands, fences, balconies and other indoor or outdoor displays. The dark green cable blends discreetly with foliage and greenery. Choose from multiple lighting effects to suit your display, while the built-in timer provides convenient daily operation. Once activated, the lights stay on for 8 hours and switch off for 16 hours before repeating the cycle at the same time each day. The 18.5m illuminated length is supported by an approximately 8m power cable. Mains powered. The transformer must remain indoors. Includes a 1-year warranty.
